$comment: contract=source-registry-schema version=1 status=DRAFT owner_task=ING-001 decisions=D-03,D-07,D-08,D-10,D-11,D-13,D-20,D-24,D-26 last_changed=2026-09-28. Produced by ING-001-S01. Every file data/contracts/sources/<source_id_lower>.v<major>.yaml validates against this schema; cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in x-bridge-loader-rules and enforced by load_registry() (ING-001-S02) before any customer connection is opened.
title: SourceContract
description: Executable activation contract of one Snowflake metadata source (Account Usage, Organization Usage, Data Sharing Usage view, or a SHOW command) extracted by the account-cycle runner (ING-106). One adapter per watermark mode; a new standard source needs only a contract file (ING-001-S03). Normative inputs: ING backlog §3 and §3.1, source-catalog.md, ADR-006 amendment, ADR-009 amendment, ADR-015 (maturity), D-08, D-11, D-13, D-20, D-26.

schema_version.description: Version of this JSON Schema the file is written against.

source_id.description: Registry identifier; also the `source=` segment of every landing key (landing-keys.v1.yaml) and the RAW table stem (RAW.<SOURCE_ID>_V<major>). Prefix AU_ = SNOWFLAKE.ACCOUNT_USAGE, OU_ = SNOWFLAKE.ORGANIZATION_USAGE, DSU_ = SNOWFLAKE.DATA_SHARING_USAGE, SHOW_ = SHOW command snapshot.

contract_version.description: Semantic version of this contract. MAJOR = schema_major (RAW table/stage/pipe generation); MINOR = additive transport change (ING-001-S06); PATCH = documentation/operational parameter change.

schema_major.description: Must equal the MAJOR of contract_version (loader rule LR-01).

status.description: Contract review status (CONVENTIONS §1). Distinct from per-environment activation.

module_requirement.description: READY guard (CON-005-S07): every REQUIRED source of every selected module must probe AVAILABLE or AVAILABLE_EMPTY; OPTIONAL failures only disable dependent features.

fq_view.description: Fully qualified view. Identifiers come only from registry constants and are emitted quoted by the query builder (ING-001-S04).

show_command.description: Only for source_kind=SHOW_COMMAND; the projection is read through TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID())) with explicit columns.

capability_flag.description: Field of the capability snapshot (capability.json account_facts) that activates extraction, e.g. adaptive_present.

extractor_columns.description: Source-specific columns computed by the extractor on plaintext before privacy transforms (ING-107 order step 1), e.g. is_bridge_overhead (G-CON-11). Technical columns common to all sources are defined in _transport.v1.yaml and never listed here.

extension_schemas.description: Named Arrow column groups appended by a library owned elsewhere (WorkloadMetaV1 = WRK-101-S05 allowlisted comment/tag metadata).

watermark_column.description: Source column the window predicate is half-open on (END_TIME for END_TIME_SWEEP, START_TIME/USAGE_DATE/DATE for partitions); null for SNAPSHOT.

pruning_horizon_days.description: END_TIME_SWEEP pruning bound (`<pruning_column> >= DATEADD(day, -<n>, :ws)`): 7-day maximum statement timeout + 1 day. Must be >= 8 for END_TIME_SWEEP.

predicate_template.description: Exact predicate with bind variables only (:ws/:we for timestamps, :ds/:de for dates, :pending_from for PENDING_REFRESH). No literal values, no string interpolation (ING-001-S04 static scan).

open_row_predicate.description: Predicate identifying still-mutable rows, e.g. QUERY_END_TIME IS NULL.

pending_predicate_template.description: Re-read predicate for the pending set: hours >= :pending_from (oldest hour holding an open row) and < :we, bounded to bound_days before :we.

horizon_alarm_days.description: Alarm watermark_horizon_breach_total when an observed END - START exceeds this (ING-002-S10: 7 d; alarm fires at > 6 d).

cycle.description: Account-cycle slot (ORC-003-S02): hourly cycle at minute 5 + (hash(connection_id) mod 50); daily sources join the 03:00 UTC-hour cycle; ORG cycle daily at 06:10 UTC.

first_delay_seconds.description: FIRST pass due at window_end + first_delay (PROVISIONAL).

settle_seconds.description: SETTLE pass due at window_end + settle; a window is settled once an accepted batch has extracted_at >= window_end + settle (ING-002-S02).

extraction_order_rank.description: Finance-first order inside a cycle and a backfill (lower first): OU billing -> MDH -> WMH/MH -> serverless/transfer/storage -> QAH -> QH (G-ING-08, ING-010-S04).

key.description: EVENT_UPSERT business key in transport names, excluding tenant/account (always prepended).

snapshot_key.description: SNAPSHOT entity key within one capture (capture = source_batch_id).

aggregation_rule.description: Declared aggregation of truly identical dimensional rows inside a complete snapshot (source-catalog common gate), or null.

expression.description: Expression over transport names, used by the suspect guard and checksums.

zero_rows.description: A new complete partition with 0 rows while the selected revision has > 0 is SUSPECT.

measure_drop_ratio.description: Decimal string. SUSPECT when sum(new) < ratio x sum(selected). null = measure rule disabled (snapshots use zero_rows only).

backfill_supported.description: false for SNAPSHOT sources (history only after first capture).

backfill_split_rows_threshold.description: Split a chunk into hour chunks when the sizing estimate exceeds this row count (ING-010-S03: 2,000,000).

sizing_query.description: Cheap aggregate used by backfill sizing (ING-010-S02), bind variables only.

retention_days.description: Documented source retention (Account Usage: 365). null when indefinite or snapshot-only.

availability_start.description: First date with data in the source irrespective of retention (e.g. 2026-01-05 for CORTEX_AI_FUNCTIONS_USAGE_HISTORY).

retention_safety_days.description: earliest = max(requested_start, now - retention_days + safety, availability_start, enrollment_at for SNAPSHOT) (ING-002-S06).

retention_edge_guard_days.description: Partitions with partition_date < now - retention_days + guard are never re-snapshotted (G-ING-07).

retention_class.description: D-26: FINANCIAL (billing, metering, storage, serverless, transfer, snapshots, inventory) keeps journal and RAW 400 d; QUERY_GRAIN (query, access, session sources) 90 d.

query_detail_tiering.description: D-11 / RECONCILIATION C-01 three tiers: HOT (<= hot_days, sanitized text), COLD (tail comment only, computed in the customer warehouse, never persisted as text), NONE.

data_final_horizon_seconds.description: D-13 charge/measurement FINAL at interval end + horizon (FIN §3.3).

attribution_final_horizon_seconds.description: D-13 attribution FINAL default (QAH: hour_end + T + 24 h, T = min(max statement timeout, 48 h) = 72 h).

month_stability_days.description: MONTH_STABLE at month end + N days (default 5; FIN-108 re-derives).

fin_policy_ref.description: Row of data/dbt/seeds/ref_source_maturity_policy.csv (FIN-104-S01) that must carry identical numbers (consistency test).

stale_after_seconds.description: 2 x (expected_lag + grace), capped at 86400 for hourly windows.

service_families.description: FIN §3.2 service_family values this source contributes to (money authority is always the UICD family bucket).

authority_rank.description: Revision selection rank: ACCOUNT_USAGE/ORGANIZATION_USAGE = 2, INFORMATION_SCHEMA hot path (R2) = 1.

effective_from.description: Half-open authority window for effective-dated chains (Cortex, replication).

oversized_row_bytes.description: A single row above this quarantines the window (16 MiB).

oversized_text_bytes.description: QUERY_TEXT above this is dropped with query_text_mode=OMITTED_SIZE (100 KiB).

may_be_empty.description: true = 0 rows in a bounded 48 h probe is AVAILABLE_EMPTY; false = SUSPECT_EMPTY unless proven otherwise (capability-classification.v1.yaml).

predicate_template.description: Bounded probe predicate with :probe_from/:probe_to binds (last 48 h) or null for SNAPSHOT_COUNT/SHOW.

fingerprint.description: sha256 over the canonical JSON of the full transport schema (technical + projection + extractor columns); algorithm in _transport.v1.yaml.

describe_sha256.description: Per-account DESCRIBE fingerprint of the projected columns (ING-009-S03: a set is accepted during BCR rollouts).

source_family.description: Bounded label used as the source_family metric dimension (OPS-001-S05 closed list).

module.description: Customer-selectable module (snowflake_privilege_map.v1.json); the module decides the SNOWFLAKE database roles rendered in the install script.

vendor_fact_status.description: VERIFIED = checked in source code or a live account; VERIFIED_SNIPPET = checked in official documentation snippets (readiness review 2026-09-28); TO_VERIFY_LIVE = must be confirmed on the INF-101 estate before activation.

roles.description: Minimal SNOWFLAKE database role(s) granting read on the view (CON-003-S01 privilege map).

alternatives.description: Roles that also grant read (e.g. GOVERNANCE_VIEWER for QAH); never rendered unless required by another module.

privacy_action.description: ING-107-S01 actions; exactly one per projected field. TIER_WINDOW = SANITIZE_SQL inside the HOT tier, not projected otherwise. DROP = read in the customer warehouse, consumed in process (e.g. is_bridge_overhead, WRK-101 fragment path), never written.

name.description: Source column (UPPER) or RESULT_SCAN column (quoted lower) or alias of an expression. '*' is impossible by pattern.

transport_name.description: Lower-snake Parquet field and RAW column name. Renamed when a privacy transform changes meaning (query_text_sanitized, user_name_pseudonym, query_tag_sanitized).

expression.description: SQL expression built only from registry constants (e.g. TRY_PARSE_JSON(CLIENT_ENVIRONMENT):APPLICATION::VARCHAR); null = plain column.

nullable.description: Source nullability as documented/observed. Key and partition columns must be false.

required.description: Required = removal/rename is BREAKING (quarantine); optional = TRANSFORMABLE (null + missing_optional flag).

arrow_type.description: pyarrow str() of the transport type per _transport.v1.yaml type map; null when privacy_action=DROP (never transported).

raw_type.description: RAW column type in RAW.<SOURCE>_V<major>; null when not transported.

exact_decimal_parse.description: VARCHAR/VARIANT numeric that dbt parses as exact decimal with quarantine-on-malformed (e.g. SERVERLESS_TASK_HISTORY.CREDITS_USED).

float_exception.description: Documented FLOAT source kept as float64 (ING-003-S04 guard allowlist); never money.

additive_only.description: true for EVENT_UPSERT sources: re-extraction of mismatched days upserts and never deletes (G-ING-07).

checksum_measures.description: Aggregates compared per END_TIME/partition day for CHECKSUM passes.

estate_account_alias.description: INF-101 estate alias, never a real locator.

x-bridge-loader-rules.rule: schema_major equals the MAJOR component of contract_version.
settle_seconds >= documented_latency_seconds when documented_latency_seconds is not null (a pass schedule shorter than the documented latency is rejected).

END_TIME_SWEEP: watermark_column and pruning_column are projected (by source name) and not nullable; predicate_template contains '<watermark_column> >= :ws AND <watermark_column> < :we' and '<pruning_column> >= DATEADD(day, -<pruning_horizon_days>, :ws)'.
Every key, snapshot_key and partition_key.column names a projected transport_name whose nullable=false.

transport_name values are unique after case folding across projection, extractor_columns, technical columns (_transport.v1.yaml) and extension schemas; no projection transport_name equals a technical column name.
primary_measure.expression references only projected transport names (or COUNT(*)); anti_entropy checksum_measures reference only projected source column names (they run in the customer warehouse).
source_id is unique across the registry; the file name is lower(source_id) + '.v' + schema_major + '.yaml'.
health numbers equal the formula of ING §3.6 computed from first_delay_seconds and window_steady_seconds (source-health.v1.yaml).
Sources whose key includes a metering hour (AU_QUERY_METERING_HISTORY) must list query_metering_hour in key (ING-001-S08 QMH grain oracle).
authority.measure_roles containing CHARGE is forbidden for SNOWFLAKE.ORGANIZATION_USAGE.MONETIZED_USAGE_DAILY and any provider or disbursement view (G-FIN-05).
maturity horizons are >= settle_seconds; numbers equal the matching ref_source_maturity_policy row (FIN-104).

arrow_type and raw_type equal the _transport.v1.yaml type map for (snowflake_type, precision, scale) unless exact_decimal_parse or float_exception is true; no 'double' arrow type unless float_exception=true (ING-003-S04).
transport_schema.fingerprint equals bridge-transport-fingerprint-v1 recomputed from the file.
query_detail_tiering is required when any projection column has tier HOT or COLD; HOT columns use privacy_action TIER_WINDOW, COLD columns use DROP.
The predicate and projection never produce 'SELECT *'; identifiers are emitted from registry constants only (ING-001-S04).
